newsitem.title: USA: Toys R Us says outlook "excellent".
newsitem.headline: Toys R Us says outlook "excellent".

text.p: Toys R Us Inc said Wednesday its outlook for this year was excellent.
The company reported a 1.0 percent increase in sales for the fiscal fourth quarter, ended February 1, to a record $4.67 billion, and a 5.0 percent increase for the year, to a record $9.93 billion.
It said the fourth quarter and year had 13 and 52 weeks, respectively, while the year-ago periods were 14 and 53 weeks long.
Excluding non-recurring items, fourth quarter earnings per share were $1.38. The First Call consensus estimate was $1.42.
For the year, Toys R Us said, earnings excluding non-recurring charges were up 12 percent, to $465 million, or $1.68 per share.
"We are pleased that each of our divisions experienced comparable-store sales increases and improved operating earnings in 1996," Chief Executive Michael Goldstein said.
"Our comparable U.S.A. toy store sales increased over 2.0 percent for the year.
"Internationally, our Canadian toy stores had high-single-digit comparable-store sales gains for the year. Our U.K. comparable-store sales were up mid-single-digits."
He said, "Our Japanese toy stores also posted increased comparable-store sales for 1996. Lower comparable-store sales were reported for Germany, France, Spain and Australia.
"At Kids R Us, comparable-store sales increased mid-single-digits and operating profits were up over 35 percent for the year."

During the year, Goldstein said, the company opened 13 "Concept 2000" stores, its new toy store design. "We are quite pleased with the results ... We will accelerate the roll-out of our new design by remodeling approximately 57 existing stores to the 'Concept 2000' format in 1997.

"We also saw the birth of our new division, Babies R Us. Our merger with Baby Superstore on February 3, 1997, has quickly catapulted Babies R Us into the premier retailer of juvenile products in the United States."
Goldstein further commented, "The outlook for 1997 (ending in early 1998) is excellent due to the abundance of strong new product offerings.
"The video game business is quite vibrant with outstanding sales of Nintendo (Co Ltd ) 64 in the United States and Canada as well as an excellent initial launch in Europe on March 1."
He said, "The Sony (Corp) Playstation continues to sell well worldwide, and recent price reductions will undoubtedly accelerate hardware sales.
"In addition, 1997 will be an outstanding year for children-oriented movies with related toy products. Currently, the 'Star Wars' movie is creating strong consumer demand at our stores.
"With the current strength of video games and action figures, our same-store sales at our U.S. and Canadian toy stores for the first five weeks of our fiscal year have been excellent.
"Our international same-store sales are also quite strong."
In 1996, Toys R Us said, it opened 30 toy stores and two KidsWorld stores in the United States. Internationally, 32 toy stores were opened.
The company's franchising operation added 27 stores to the Toys R Us family, including five new countries: Indonesia, Italy, Saudi Arabia, South Africa and Turkey.

It said Kids R Us and Babies R Us opened seven and six stores, respectively. Store expansion plans include about 25 new toy stores and five new Kids R Us stores in the United States. In addition, it will add about 20 new Babies R Us locations.
"Internationally, we will open approximately 40 new stores, including 15 franchise stores," it said.
((--New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610))
